test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 Quant Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: general
question:
Which fraction among the following is the least ?

(5)/(11), (7)/(12), (8)/(13), (9)/(17)
solution:
**Given:**

Fractions: (5)/(11), (7)/(12), (8)/(13), (9)/(17)

**Formula used:**

Fraction comparison by decimal conversion.

**Calculation:**

⇒ (5)/(11) approx 0.454

⇒ (7)/(12) approx 0.583

⇒ (8)/(13) approx 0.615

⇒ (9)/(17) approx 0.529

⇒ 0.454 

⇒ Least value = (5)/(11)

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
